title: Refund shows the wrong currency
description: A customer paying in yen saw the refund email quote the amount in euros.

comments.author: Elena Rossi
comments.body: Root cause: refunds used the settlement currency of our account instead of the currency the customer paid in.

comments.author: Elena Rossi
comments.body: Fixed by storing the presentment currency on the order and using it for refunds and emails.

comments.author: Elena Rossi
comments.body: Gotcha: yen has no decimal places, so amounts must not be multiplied by 100 for zero-decimal currencies.
